topic: Data report review and distribution strategy
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several points regarding a data report. Initially, [p1] suggested adding signal level limitations (e.g., -78 for signal level) to the 'reason of difference' section in the report, noting that charts for Malls align better with current data due to consistent signal levels.

Regarding distribution, there was discussion about whether to send the report to Gabrielle. [p2] suggested against it, citing potential confusion, and noted that DataCorp had no questions regarding the data release. 

It was decided that the initial distribution should be limited to AFA Denmark. The consensus was reached to include the presentation under the official release notes. Furthermore, a suggestion was made to provide recipients with access to staging numbers so they can independently evaluate the data.
decisions: The report should incorporate signal level limitations into the 'reason of difference' section.
The initial distribution of the report and presentation will be limited to AFA Denmark.
The presentation material should be included under the official release notes.
Recipients should be given access to staging numbers for independent data evaluation.
action_items: Update the report documentation to include signal limitation details.
Prepare and send the materials specifically to AFA Denmark first.
